dct_description_sm: Map of Asia from the 1542 edition of Munster's Geographia.; Relief shown pictorially.; Latin text on verso: India nova.; ""The first edition can be distinguished by the single decorative printer's device to the left of the title. The second edition includes the same printer's device on both sides of the title."" -- Dealer's description.; Includes illustrations of a large, fishlike sea monster and a two-tailed mermaid.
26 x 34 centimeters on sheet 32 x 39 centimeters
